info.title: TruckBuddy API
info.description: Voice copilot for truckers: Google Places, HERE truck routing, OpenAI STT/LLM/TTS, satellite parking checks.

post.description: A new access token for a device's refresh token (the refresh token rotates).

get.description:
Liveness and the providers in use (public); ?deep=1 (tester token only) also checks the database and one
HERE call (cached DEEP_CACHE_S) and answers 503 when either fails.

mp3 with byte-range support (AVPlayer on iOS probes with Range: bytes=0-1). A clip still being streamed
is served as it arrives: a probe gets 206 with the first byte, a full request gets a 200 stream.

post.description: Binds this device to the fleet (and truck) the code was made for; answers with a token carrying the org.

get.description:
The truck profile the server routes for when the app sends none: the vehicle's when the device is bound to
one, else the driver's. 404 when nothing is stored yet (the app keeps its local copy). X-Profile-Source says
which: "vehicle" is the fleet's truck, which a driver's own change does not overwrite (it holds for the trip
on the phone), "driver" is the driver's own copy.

delete.description:
"Delete my data": the dialogs, the remembered turns and facts, the trip events (after the saves still in
flight land) and the driver's own stored truck profile (a fleet truck's profile belongs to the fleet).
`deleted` counts turns, as before.

post.description: Anything the copilot wants to say on its own right now (break due, parking before the shift ends).

The app detected the driver left the route: a new route from the current position to the same place.
No new satellite check (the destination hasn't changed); the cached verdict comes along, its entry tip
phrased for the way this route arrives.

get.description: Result of a breakdown research started by /agent (status=researching); waits until it's ready.

post.description:
Pre-fetch Places for all categories (+ satellite check for the top place) around the driver.
At most once per driver per WARM_EVERY_S; the answer is always ok (the app ignores it).

Step 1 of a voice turn: speech -> text (the app shows it right away, then calls /agent?speak=true).

`maybe=1`: the app's mic heard sound but no clear speech (src/voice/endpointer.ts). A short, unsure or
made-up-from-noise transcript then comes back empty, so the agent never answers a "Thank you." nobody said.
`lang` (or the X-Lang header): the recogniser's language and prompt (services/voice.stt_language_and_prompt).
TTS for fixed copilot lines (onboarding, reminders). Cached per text, one generation per text.
A batch from the app; all or nothing (a bad event is a 422 for the batch, so the app drops it).

get.description: Latest events across drivers (pseudonymous ids), for the tester screen and the stats script.

The org's trucks with where each was last seen (the last event that carried a position) and whether a
route is running (the last route_started vs route_ended).

One truck's day, oldest first, without transcripts; 404 for a truck that is not the caller's. `truncated`
says the day has more than `limit` events (the list used to stop at 2000 with nothing to say so, bug 10).

put.description:
The truck's sizes, which every driver of it routes with: the owner's and the dispatcher's to set (a driver
changes only the trip, from the phone). 404 for a truck that is not the caller's.

get.description:
Per truck for the day: routes started, reroutes, far-stop questions the guard asked, failed copilot turns,
routing failures. Events from a phone not bound to a truck are counted under vehicle_id null.
The org's drivers (ids to map to Motive users; no device tokens).

put.description:
Which Motive user this driver is, so the fleet key fetches their clocks (null unlinks); owner only, like
the key itself. 409 when another driver of the fleet is already that Motive user.
The fleet's time zone (IANA name, e.g. America/Chicago): its "today" in the summary and a truck's day.
The fleet's Motive API key, stored encrypted (services/secrets.py); owner only, never read back.

Approach.title: Approach
Approach.description: How the driver arrives: heading over the last 300 m and the street of the last maneuver.

ChainControl.title: ChainControl
ChainControl.description: A Caltrans chain-control point; `index` is the geometry index of the route near it (−1 when unplaced).

Incident.title: Incident
Incident.description: Traffic incident on the route (HERE return=incidents); `index` is where it starts in the geometry.

MapsSource.title: MapsSource
MapsSource.description:
A Google Maps place citation of a grounded answer (services.maps_grounding): Google's terms want it shown right
under the answer, attributed to "Google Maps", one tap away.

NearbyLot.title: NearbyLot
NearbyLot.description: A truck-capable lot elsewhere in the satellite frame (when the place itself won't fit).

NudgeRequest.title: NudgeRequest
NudgeRequest.description: The app's periodic "anything to say?" while driving (every few minutes).

RerouteRequest.title: RerouteRequest
RerouteRequest.description: The driver left the active route: a new route from where they are, back onto the old one if possible.

Review.title: Review
Review.description: One Google review. Google's terms: show the author and link to the review when displayed.

SpeedLimit.title: SpeedLimit
SpeedLimit.description:
Posted limit from `index` in RouteInfo.geometry until the next entry (HERE spans=maxSpeed); None = no
posted limit known from here (a ramp, a road HERE has no data for), so nothing is shown or judged.

UiState.title: UiState
UiState.description: What the app shows right now (so the copilot knows what it can toggle).

WeatherAlert.title: WeatherAlert
WeatherAlert.description: An active NWS alert on the route; `index` is the geometry index of the first sample point it covers.
